bio:
I am an **Algorithm Lead** in the AIGC Code-Generation group at **Hithink RoyalFlush AI Research Institute** (浙江核新同花顺), where I build *enterprise-grade code-generation frameworks* for human–agent collaborative development, *generative visual analytics* for finance, and *visual narrative paradigms* for vertical scenarios — serving tens of millions of users across dozens of products.

I received my **Ph.D.** from the *State Key Lab of CAD & CG, Zhejiang University* (2017–2023), advised by Prof. *Wei Chen*, and was a CSC-funded **visiting Ph.D.** at *TU Munich* under Prof. *Rüdiger Westermann* (2021–2022). I completed my **postdoctoral research** jointly hosted by Hithink and ZJU (2023–2025) on visual generative LLMs for finance.

I currently serve as an **AC Committee Member of YOCSEF Hangzhou** (CCF). My research lies at the intersection of **Code Generation, AIGC**, and **Information Visualization & Visual Analytics**.

cta.title: Work with Me
cta.body: I'm actively recruiting **research interns**, **algorithm engineers**, and **collaborators** for our AIGC Code-Generation and Financial Visual-Analytics teams at Hithink. If you're excited about *human–agent collaborative development*, *visual generative LLMs*, or *interactive visualization at industry scale*, I'd love to hear from you.

news.text: New preprint: *Chart-FR1: Visual Focus-Driven Fine-Grained Reasoning on Dense Charts* is out on **arXiv**.
Successfully completed my **postdoctoral research** at Hithink × ZJU.
Won **Winner Award** at *PacificVis 2025 Visualization Storytelling Contest*.
*SGCR: A Specification-Grounded Framework for Trustworthy LLM Code Review* accepted at **ASE 2025** (CCF-A).
*HiVis: A Web-Based Library for Financial Data Visualizations* accepted at **ChinaVis 2025**.
*A Summarization-Based Pattern-Aware Matrix Reordering Approach* accepted at **JCST** (CCF-B).
Awarded *2024 浙江省博士后科研项目择优资助 (Second Class)* — **Principal Investigator**.
Two papers accepted to **PacificVis 2024**: *Nuwa: An Authoring Tool for Graph Visualizations* and *GraphFederator*.
Joined **Hithink RoyalFlush** as Algorithm Lead for AIGC Code Generation.
Successfully defended my Ph.D. thesis at Zhejiang University.
